situations.title: 배뇨통·빈뇨 문진(UTI)
situations.tagline: It burns when I pee and I keep having to go all the time.
situations.brief: 배뇨통·빈뇨의 발현과 소변 양상을 문진해 요로감염을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the burning with urination start?
How often are you needing to urinate?
Have you noticed any blood or strong odor in your urine?

situations.title: 청결채뇨(clean catch) 설명
situations.tagline: How exactly do I collect the urine sample the right way?
situations.brief: 중간뇨(clean catch) 채취 절차를 단계별로 이해하기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: First, clean the area with the wipe we give you.
Start urinating, then catch the middle part of the stream in the cup.
Try not to touch the inside of the cup.

situations.title: 요폐(소변 못 봄)
situations.tagline: I haven't been able to pee for hours and my lower belly feels full.
situations.brief: 방광 팽만과 마지막 배뇨 시점을 사정하고 도뇨의 필요성을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: When was the last time you were able to urinate?
Does your lower belly feel full or tender?
We may need to place a small catheter to drain your bladder.

situations.title: 육안적 혈뇨 주소
situations.tagline: My urine turned red today and it really frightened me.
situations.brief: 혈뇨의 통증 유무와 발현 시점·양상을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Is there any pain when you urinate?
When did you first notice the red color?
Is the blood at the start, the end, or throughout?

situations.title: 도뇨관 삽입 절차 설명
situations.tagline: Will putting in the catheter hurt? I'm nervous about it.
situations.brief: 무균 도뇨 절차와 예상되는 불편감을 설명하며 환자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: You may feel some pressure, but it shouldn't be sharply painful.
We keep everything sterile to prevent infection.
Tell me if you feel any discomfort and I'll go slowly.

situations.title: 신산통(요관결석)
situations.tagline: The pain in my side comes in waves and shoots down to my groin.
situations.brief: 옆구리에서 서혜부로 방사하는 산통을 사정하고 진통·CT를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Does the pain come in waves or stay constant?
Does it travel from your side down toward your groin?
We'll give you pain medicine and arrange a CT scan.

situations.title: 급성 신우신염
situations.tagline: I have a high fever, chills, and my back is really sore.
situations.brief: 발열·CVA 압통을 사정하고 배양 후 항생제 투여를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Does it hurt when I tap over your back here?
Have you had fever, chills, or nausea?
We'll get a urine culture before starting antibiotics.

situations.title: 남성 요폐(전립선)
situations.tagline: I've had trouble going for weeks, and now I can't go at all.
situations.brief: 전립선 관련 요폐를 사정하고 방광스캔과 잔뇨량 측정을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you had a weak stream or trouble starting for a while?
We'll do a quick bladder scan to see how full it is.
This will tell us how much urine is left inside.

situations.title: 고환염전 청소년
situations.tagline: My testicle suddenly started hurting really badly a couple hours ago.
situations.brief: 급성 음낭통의 발현을 사정하고 즉시 초음파·비뇨기 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Exactly when did the pain start?
This can be an emergency, so we're moving quickly.
We're arranging an urgent ultrasound and calling the specialist.

situations.title: 카테터 관련 요로감염
situations.tagline: I have a long-term catheter and now I have a fever and cloudy urine.
situations.brief: 장기 유치 도뇨관과 감염 징후를 사정하고 교체 필요성을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: How long has the catheter been in place?
Has your urine become cloudy or foul-smelling?
We may need to change the catheter and check for infection.

situations.title: 혈뇨+항응고제
situations.tagline: I'm on blood thinners and now there's blood in my urine.
situations.brief: 혈뇨의 원인과 항응고제 복용력을 통합 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner are you taking, and when was your last dose?
Is there any pain along with the blood in your urine?
Have you had any recent injury or catheter?

situations.title: 투석 환자 응급
situations.tagline: I missed my dialysis and now I feel awful and swollen.
situations.brief: 투석 스케줄과 혈관통로를 확인하고 응급 상태를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When was your last dialysis session?
Which arm has your access, so we avoid it for blood pressure?
Have you had trouble breathing or swelling in your legs?
goals: 결손 투석에 따른 응급 상태를 사정한다

situations.title: 결석+구토 탈수
situations.tagline: The kidney stone pain makes me vomit and I can't keep water down.
situations.brief: 결석 통증에 동반된 구토·탈수를 사정하고 수액·항구토·배출 교육을 하세요.
keyPhrases: How many times have you vomited today?
We'll give you fluids and medicine to settle your stomach.
We'll ask you to strain your urine to catch the stone.

situations.title: 임신 중 신우신염
situations.tagline: I'm pregnant and I have a fever with pain in my back.
situations.brief: 임신 중 신우신염에서 태아 안전과 약물 선택을 고려해 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: How many weeks pregnant are you?
We'll choose antibiotics that are safe during pregnancy.
We'll also check on the baby's wellbeing.
goals: 태아 안전과 약물 선택을 고려해 안내한다

situations.title: 반복 결석 환자 교육
situations.tagline: This is my third stone this year — how do I stop getting them?
situations.brief: 반복 결석 환자에게 수분·식이 예방 전략을 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: Drinking plenty of water is one of the best ways to prevent stones.
We can review foods that may raise your risk.
Following up with a urologist can help find the cause.

situations.title: 폐쇄성 요로감염 패혈증
situations.tagline: I have a stone, a high fever, and I feel like I might pass out.
situations.brief: 결석·발열·저혈압을 통합 인지하고 응급 감압과 패혈증 치료를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Your fever and low blood pressure make this an emergency.
We're starting fluids and antibiotics right away.
You may need an urgent procedure to relieve the blockage.

situations.title: 고칼륨혈증 위기(무뇨)
situations.tagline: I haven't been able to urinate at all and I feel weak everywhere.
situations.brief: 무뇨에 동반된 고칼륨혈증을 인지하고 심전도·응급 투석을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're getting an ECG right away to check your heart.
Your potassium may be dangerously high, so we're acting fast.
You may need emergency dialysis.

situations.title: 신부전 폐부종
situations.tagline: I can't catch my breath and my legs are hugely swollen.
situations.brief: 신부전에 동반된 폐부종을 인지하고 산소·응급 투석을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving you oxygen and sitting you upright to help you breathe.
The fluid overload may need urgent dialysis to remove.
Try to take slow breaths — we're right here.

situations.title: 음경지속발기증
situations.tagline: It's been painfully erect for hours and won't go down.
situations.brief: 시간 민감성을 인지하고 비뇨기 협진을 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: How many hours has this been going on?
This is time-sensitive, so we're contacting the specialist now.
We'll give you pain medicine while we prepare treatment.

situations.title: 외상성 방광파열
situations.tagline: After the crash I can't pee and there's blood — my pelvis really hurts.
situations.brief: 골반골절 동반 방광파열을 인지하고 방광조영과 외상 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you been able to pass any urine since the accident?
We're going to do a special X-ray of your bladder with contrast.
We're keeping the trauma team involved for your pelvis.

situations.title: 신성 위기 급변 인계
situations.tagline: I've barely made any urine all shift and I feel worse now.
situations.brief: 소변량과 칼륨 추이의 급변을 파악해 당직에 신속히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: How much have you urinated over the last few hours?
Your labs have changed, so I'm updating the doctor.
I'll report your urine output and potassium trend clearly.
